title: How to configure Canon for a monorepo with multiple spec directories?
body:
We have a monorepo with this structure:

```
apps/
  frontend/docs/specs/
  backend/docs/specs/
packages/
  shared/docs/specs/
```

Is there a way to configure Canon to look at all three directories? I tried setting `specs.doc_paths` in CANON.yaml but it only seems to accept one pattern.

Thanks!
